summary: Steep cul-de-sac kerb with homes 12-14 m away on the same side.

drivers.seclusion: Gardens and houses back straight onto the kerb, 12-14 m away on this side and more all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a van-sized kerb, but a steep fall of about 13% along the whole section.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the kerb, but there is no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 13% grade, over the 12% limit
Dwellings 12-14 m away on same side
Witton Creek 23 m away; ground is 38-44 m, not low-lying
sun_shade: Mostly open, with trees at the western side giving some afternoon shade.

best_section.where: West kerb at the head of Gilia Court's cul-de-sac bulb
